value.hook: Open before deciding whether a process is a seat (registration, status line, send identity), handling omp -p / claude -p / copilot -p children, or picking up F197
value.title: Seat children, one-shot runs and nearest-host ownership (F197, F198, #240)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Harness mode signals for "is this a one-shot run?", all measured live:
- OMP/pi: ExtensionContext.mode is tui|rpc|json|print; print and json are one-shot, rpc is a long-lived host-driven root and still registers. hasUI is false in both print and rpc, so it can't tell them apart.
- Claude: CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT is `cli` interactive, `sdk-cli` for `claude -p`. Treat unset as interactive.
- Copilot -p: NO signal. Env and capabilities match the TUI; only `canvases` differs, and that isn't a documented mode flag. Extensions do load in -p. The daemon brake covers it.

Daemon brake (F197, branch f197-print-mode-no-seat, f6ad1246, parked with no PR yet): refuse a registration whose caller descends from the pane's live registered holder (E-RS-PANE-HOLDER-CHILD, HTTP 400), whatever id or session it claims, so a child can't take the parent's own id either. Parents are read in-process via pij_harnesses::proc::parent_and_host_name, at most 64 hops, and only when other live local rows are on the pane. No launches. Own non-child rows, dead holders (F196) and non-descendant siblings keep their old paths.

Send identity: a one-shot child's in-harness pij_send refuses with E-NOREG and points to shell `pij send`, which resolves to the pane's seat (the parent). Never give the child an identity of its own.

Status line (F198): name a seat only when the NEAREST harness host above the status process (copilot, node, claude, codex, omp, bun, pi) IS the seat's recorded pid+start. Skip shell wrappers; an outer registered host never counts. On Linux, strip " (deleted)" from the /proc exe basename, or upgraded binaries misread.

Live smoke for -p: `omp -p --no-extensions -e <worktree>/.omp/extensions/pij/index.ts --model=github-copilot/claude-haiku-4.5 "Reply with just: hi"`. gpt-5-mini and gpt-5.4-mini fail with "not available for integrator".
